name: Tooltip
description: A short hint in ink that shows on hover and focus, with an optional arrow and key hint.

props.name: children
props.description: A focusable element, usually a Button or IconButton, then the Tooltip.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds of hover before the tooltip shows. Keyboard focus shows it at once, and so does moving from one tooltip to the next.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before it hides after the pointer leaves.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the tooltip shows or hides.

props.name: children
props.description: The hint. At most 240 pixels wide; keep it short.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where it shows relative to the trigger. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A key or key combination shown after the text in a lighter chip, e.g. "⌘K".

props.name: arrow
props.description: Draws a small arrow pointing at the trigger.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap from the trigger in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Tooltip.
